description: Approximately 300 people attended, including around 100 fathers and male carers, 100 children and young people aged 5–24, and a wider group of mothers, grandparents, volunteers and community members. The day was filled with father-and-child races, football challenges, dance performances, spoken-word acts, and facilitated men's discussions on vulnerability and love.

description: Our 2024 Roots & Wings flagship event was a powerful celebration of fatherhood and family unity. Through high-energy sports, football matches, and community activities, we brought fathers and children together to build resilience and strengthen intergenerational bonds. This event exemplified our mission: empowering families and creating a vibrant, supportive community where every father's role is celebrated and every child is inspired.
